fc913509039412790aa2427558d35178aa7842ea
Modified for HomePod Bridge: optional stream-SETUP-before-RECORD ordering (default unchanged), advertised local UDP data port, explicit initial/maximum volume policy, mandatory initial mute acknowledgement before audio/readiness, transient SRP event-channel key derivation and encrypted keep-alive handling, and bounded protocol diagnostics. Corresponding protocol regression tests are included. See marked source files and docs/development.md. The example is omitted. Android integration lives in app/src/main/cpp.
